summary: New page: 2025 Northwest Region champions hero, region scoreboard, road to Williamsport with the District and State title dates, all six August scores, a 2025 and 2026 honor roll, then Spring 2027 registration.

sources.fact: 2025 Majors baseball All-Stars won the District 10 title on a 7th-inning walk-off home run.
2025 10-12 baseball All-Stars won the Washington State championship.
The 2025 State championship game was at HB Fuller Park, Vancouver, WA, on Saturday (Jul 19).
2025 10-12 baseball All-Star coaches: Scott Seibert, Chris Heacox, Andy Audette.
Welcome-home celebration Sep 6, 2025, with the City of Bonney Lake and the opening of a new ADA playground; UW baseball coach Eddie Smith spoke.
2025 9-11 softball All-Stars won District 10 and went to State.
2025 10U softball All-Stars finished 3rd at the Washington State tournament.
2026 Majors (10-11-12) softball All-Stars won District 10, undefeated, and went to State.
2026 Majors softball All-Stars played at the State tournament.
2026 8-9-10 baseball All-Stars won District 10, 19-4 over South Hill.
2026 10U baseball All-Stars finished 3rd at the Washington State tournament.
2026 spring: Softball Majors Huskies won the District 10 Interlock championship, 10-0 over Kent.
2026 spring division champions: Baseball Majors Pirates and Baseball Minors Tin Caps.
2026 spring: Juniors Baseball Panthers won the district end-of-season championship game, 16-0.
2026 spring: Softball Juniors Party Animals were division champions and 2nd at the District championships.
